residual_add_boundary.required_missing_api: Tensor residual-add API accepting caller-provided output storage, e.g. add_out/broadcast_add_out(&self, rhs, &mut output)
known_public_blocking_ops: std::ops::Add for Tensor/&Tensor delegates to Tensor::add and returns Result<Tensor>
residual_add_boundary.why_no_runtime_slice: The current public Candle residual-add surface returns owned Tensor outputs. Reusing TransformerForwardWorkspace-owned block output storage would require writing the residual-add result into caller-provided storage without aliasing residual input or branch output in a way that changes Candle semantics.

api_integration_plan.upstream_component: candle-core Tensor add/broadcast_add output-storage API or verified backend-local equivalent
repo_local_prerequisites: Add a narrow TransformerForwardWorkspace-owned block output storage slot keyed by shape, dtype, and device.
Thread the caller-provided output storage only through the transformer.block.output residual-add boundary.
Keep the existing owned-output Candle path as the default until before/after receipts pass.
Record receipt metadata for residual input shape, branch output shape, block output shape, dtype, device, selected residual-add path, and fallback status.
Run paired Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 strict CPU before/after receipts with allocation audit enabled.

Require unchanged model SHA, tokenizer authority, prompt/generated IDs, decoded text, selected backend/kernel identity, dense hook identity where applicable, and fallback_used=false before any allocation or timing improvement claim.

accepted_output_storage_api_shape.output: caller-provided Tensor storage owned by TransformerForwardWorkspace
required_guards: no unsafe aliasing of lhs/rhs/output unless backend semantics explicitly allow it
strict receipts prove generated identity is unchanged

lane_decision.reason: The residual-add output-storage path has a concrete API contract but no available public Candle API or verified backend-local equivalent in this workspace.
lane_decision.next_safe_work: Move runtime allocation work to another measured Qwen3/Qwen2.5 allocation frontier with an available behavior-preserving API surface, or return to residual-add only after an add_out/broadcast_add_out-style API can be adopted and proven with paired strict receipts.
lane_decision.ripr_issue_reason: No ripr failure is involved in this blocker; CI ripr coverage belongs to PR hygiene, while the residual-add blocker is a Candle tensor output-storage API gap.
